title: Excel to PostgreSQL INSERT template
description: Maps worksheets of any structurally compatible .xlsx workbook onto ordered INSERT tasks. Version 1.x; a runner must reject any other major version.

row.description: With mode "row" (1.10): the worksheet row the data starts at, wherever the header is.

lastRow.description: Last worksheet row the source reads (1.10); rows below it are ignored.

parameters.description: Values the person running the import picks (1.1), used by mappings with source.mode "parameter".

default.description: Value selected at first; the runner may override it.

source.description: A dropdown of the rows of a table: the value of valueColumn is used, labelColumn is what the person reads and searches.

filter.description: Only the rows whose `column`, as text, equals the value are offered (1.4). The value is either `value` (fixed) or `parameter` (the value picked in another dropdown); give exactly one.

sourceId.description: Omit it only when the task reads a table column with a distinct source (1.8).

optional.description: Only with a `header` source: when the worksheet has no such header, the column is left out of the INSERT instead of failing.

anyOf.description: A value chosen when the import runs (1.1).
The value of `column` that the INSERT of an earlier task returned (RETURNING) for the same worksheet row (1.3).
The same text for every row (1.7). Not for processors.
The different values of a table column (1.8): the task inserts one row for each. The runner reads them from the database. Processors may follow; the task can hold no other column of the worksheet.

The cells of one worksheet column from row `fromRow` to row `toRow`, both included, as an array of texts (1.9); blank cells are empty texts. Give `column` (with a fixed header) or `header` (with a detected one). The same array goes to every row of the task. Only a case processor (without split) may follow.

toRow.description: Last worksheet row. Default: the last row with a value in the column.

anyOf.description: Several columns of the worksheet written as one text (1.7); processors may follow. Use column letters with a fixed header and header names with a detected one.

separator.description: Written between the parts. Default a space.

skipBlank.description: Leave out the parts that are blank. Default true.

processor.description: What happens to the cell text before it is inserted (1.1). Not for parameters.

anyOf.description: split: the text as an array of strings.

case.description: Convert the text to upper or lower case before cutting it (1.4); what a case block feeding the split does.

anyOf.description: case (1.4): the text in upper or lower case. With `split` the text is first cut like the split processor and every element is converted: the result is an array.
map (1.5): replaces the text by the `to` of the first pair whose `from` equals it (trimmed, ignoring case unless caseSensitive).

otherwise.description: A text that is in no pair: keep it (default), insert NULL or report an error.

anyOf.description: convert (1.5): the text as a date (YYYY-MM-DD), timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS), number or boolean (true/false). A text that cannot be converted is an error.

order.description: Order of day, month and year for dates written with / . or -. Default dmy.

anyOf.description: clean (1.7): tidies the text.

collapseSpaces.description: Runs of white space become one space and the ends are trimmed. Default true.

removeControl.description: Remove control and zero-width characters; a non-breaking space becomes a space. Default true.

removeAccents.description: Remove the accents of letters. Default false.

anyOf.description: extract (1.7): a part of the text, by position (substring) or by a regular expression (regex).

start.description: substring: first character, counting from 1. Default 1.

length.description: substring: how many characters. Default: up to the end.

group.description: regex: the capture group to keep. Default 0, the whole match.

otherwise.description: Nothing to extract: insert NULL (default), keep the text, or report an error.

anyOf.description: default (1.7): the text to use when the cell is blank. It must be the first processor.

distinct (1.8): keeps the first of each different text (blank texts are dropped), so the task inserts one row for each different value. Processors before it work on every cell, the ones after it on each different value. One per column; the task can hold no other worksheet column.

ignoreCase.description: A and a are the same value. Default false.

stopAtEmpty.description: Stop reading rows at the first blank cell of the column instead of skipping the blanks. Default false.

anyOf.description: lookup (1.2): the value of valueColumn in the row of the table whose matchColumn equals the cell text, found when the task runs.

onMissing.description: No row matches: error (default) or null.

processors.description: Processors applied in order (1.6), each to the text the one before gave. Only the last may make an array (split) or look a key up (lookup); the others are case without split, map or convert. Use `processor` for a single one; never both.

anyOf.description: split: the text as an array of strings.
